description: Fixture clips for the Phase 8 voice-backend evaluation (ADR-010). Each entry pairs a WAV with the sentence it should transcribe to, the identifiers the learner would actually need, the vocabulary hints the app would derive for it, and a category so the report can break results down. Sentences are drawn from this repository's own vocabulary on purpose.
source_note: The clips committed alongside this manifest are SYNTHETIC — generated by the local Kokoro backend via evaluation/make_voice_fixtures.py so the harness runs end to end. They measure how each ASR backend handles this vocabulary in a clean, consistent voice; they do not measure a real human speaker. Replace them with hand-recorded clips (same ids, same references) and set source to "human" for the numbers that matter.

clips.reference: the worker calls run_layer_b after the structural analysis finishes
the fill blank grader falls back to grade_fill_blank when there is no exact match
each question copies its subsystem_key so mastery survives a re-index
the job lives in app/worker/pipeline.py and publishes progress over redis
the provider protocol is defined in llm_provider.py under app/semantics
the api talks to postgres through asyncpg and enqueues jobs with arq
tree-sitter parses each file and sqlmodel maps the rows to postgres
the frontend is react with vite and the tests run under vitest
the study guide explains how the system works and why rather than listing every file
only the answer the learner confirms is ever graded so a mistake in the transcript costs nothing
